body:
I think Ketamine is a picky drug. It only grabs the people with potential, only the smart ones. Or maybe those are the only ones who can see how incredible she is. Who knows, maybe both. She seduces you, draws you in so slowly and subtly that when when you're already burried you have no idea how you got there. There were always signs and there was always fear but you never realise that while warning yourself to stop you go in deeper. It doesn't tempt you with a state of well being, it tempts you with knowledge. Because she shows you everything you always wanted to know. Even when you're sober you see things in the perspective that she's offered you.
The people who want to save you, you destroy them. They want to show you that they can maintain control even after they've felt her full effects. But they only think they know where she can take them. You show them what she's capable of and soon enough, they're following you deeper and deeper into k-space until, no matter how clean you are, you can never leave that dimension completely.
It gives you answers to questions you never knew you wanted to ask. She always gives you the absolute truth and you're in love with that truth cause you know everything down there is relative, but here... Oh here lies the true meaning.
It's so easy at first. It only teases you. Gives you something you've never had before, no matter what you've tried. A unique sensation. But you don't know her then. You enjoy her. You don't love her. You find her at parties and you end up going to places where you know she'll be without even realising. Some are lucky. Some never find out what she can do. But to those she reveals herself to... There is nothing but her.
I don't think ketamine is evil. There is no evil or good in that world. I just think that we're not prepared for what it can do. She can show you things that transcend our genetic evolution. She destroys because she is much too much.
I know I haven't exactly described an experience or trip. It's more of an overview... And I'm sure that there are people who will know exactly what I am saying.
